newFindings.finding: hostileInputTotalityContract states 'Every checking layer is total over hostile parsed JSON. Malformed input returns a deterministic finding and never an exception, at the root, at every root key and at every nested schema node', sets requiredEscapes to 0, and specifies the measurement as 'The selftest calls the unguarded checking layers directly, so a broad exception handler cannot mask an escape. Both the unguarded escape count and the guarded escape count must be zero.' That claim is false. _grammar_delta_findings consumes a candidate-supplied path string at line 2845 as `leaf = _path_steps(path)[-1]` after checking only isinstance(path, str). An empty or unparsable path raises Malformed straight out of candidate_layers. The two sibling sites that consume candidate-supplied paths - _registry_findings at line 2518 and _producer_obligation_findings at line 2795 - both wrap the call in `try/except Malformed` and emit a finding. The third was missed.
newFindings.evidence: My exhaustive fuzz drove 58358 hostile cases through the UNGUARDED candidate_layers over all 2653 paths of the candidate at unlimited depth and every array index. It recorded 44 unguarded escapes, every one at successorDelta.grammarEditorialDelta[N].path for N in 0..10, for exactly the four injected strings that are empty or unparsable as a path (empty string, 'a\x00b\x1fc\x7f', 'e\u0301\ufeff\U0001f600', and 'sha256:' + 64 zeros). 11 rows x 4 values = 44. The exception is always Malformed; no AttributeError or TypeError occurred anywhere in the 58358 cases. These are escapes under the artifact's OWN operative definition: hostile_matrix counts any exception out of candidate_layers as an escape (`except Exception: escapes += 1`), and selftest fails when hostile['escapes'] is nonzero.
newFindings.whyTheAuthorsProbeReportsZero: _hostile_nodes builds its node list from the root, the root keys, and then only those children for which isinstance(child, (dict, list)) holds. Scalar leaf positions such as successorDelta.grammarEditorialDelta[0].path are therefore never injected at. The declared measurement of '2992 hostile cases over 240 schema nodes' is taken over a strictly smaller space than the rule it is offered as evidence for. Had the enumerator included scalar leaves, the author's own --selftest would have failed.

The first clause is mechanically enforced by an AST scan of the checker's own source; the second is not. _selftest_reachability_findings locates only the FIRST --selftest dispatch and compares its index to the findings return; it never enumerates the dispatch statements in main() and never compares the flag literals present in the source to checkerModeContract.entrypoints, which is itself a checker-source literal that no layer cross-checks against the code.

observations.note: main() takes positional[0] and discards any further positional arguments without comment. `check-evidence-v9.py <clean> <dirty> --selftest` exits 0 with SELFTEST-PASS, having silently ignored the second path. No incorrect claim is made about the file actually checked, but a caller who mistypes an invocation receives no warning. An unknown flag degrades to a positional path and therefore to exit 2, which is consistent with the declared exit-code table.

selftest() prints the fixed string 'SELFTEST-PASS: evidence.v9.json' rather than the actual candidate path. Because the only candidate that can reach that line is byte-identical to the derived successor, the label is accurate in every reachable case; it would nevertheless mislabel a clean candidate supplied from another path if the equality layer were ever relaxed.

_derived_root_findings returns the single generic finding 'derived roots have no derivation context' when authority.context has not been set by a prior expected_successor call, so the per-root d9Mapping, requestContextBinding, dependencies and canonicalWireGrammar comparisons do not run. It fails CLOSED, and every reachable CLI path (normal, --selftest, and the internal hostile matrix) warms the context first, so this is not exploitable. It is worth noting only because a future caller invoking the layers directly would get materially weaker checking with no signal that coverage was reduced.

The candidate discloses this itself in retainedResiduals[8]: the grammar is bound to the encoder through its machine-readable tag, field-name and field-order table, and the prose is checked for the exact set rule only. I confirmed the binding is real - a tag edit, a field-order edit and an inverted set rule all change the derived bytes and are rejected - and that the v8 sort ambiguity (residual EV8-IR-R4) is now resolved in the prose: 'the sort is over the unframed item record bytes and happens BEFORE 0x8b framing'. My independent decoder, written from the prose alone, reproduced the shipped bytes on the first attempt, which the v8 reviewer's decoder could not.

scopedPositiveObservations: The repair is architectural rather than patch-shaped: v9 replaces v8's exclusion-list drift control with whole-object derivation of the successor from pinned bytes, which is why my 105 independent mutations found no escape rather than merely fewer escapes.

The candidate is fully reconstructible: --emit-candidate regenerates the frozen 174207-byte artifact byte-for-byte from the 24 pinned inputs, so the artifact carries no information that is not derived.

Transitive trust is enforced, not assumed: tampering with check-d9-v1.12.py, which is NOT among v9's 24 pins, still fails closed because the pinned D9 v1.13 checker verifies its own inherited lineage pins.

The disposition layer refuses to let a closure claim outlive its evidence: a probe that does not run and pass in the same invocation invalidates every disposition citing it, which I observed firing without having engineered it.

The artifact's self-assessment is honest. Its four open residuals, its measurement residual and its grammar-prose limitation match my own independent findings, and it declines to claim closure on the tautology residual EV8-IR-R3 that my leaf-provenance measurement independently confirms.

The single blocking finding is a bounded omission rather than a design failure: two of the three candidate-supplied path consumers are already correctly guarded, so the repair is to make the third match its siblings and to widen one node enumerator. Nothing in the derivation, recomputation, termination, disposition or trust-root architecture is implicated.
